newsitem.title: USA: Maine's March revenues 3.0 pct short of projection.
newsitem.headline: Maine's March revenues 3.0 pct short of projection.

text.p: Maine state revenues in March ran 3.0 percent behind projections, though revenues are still 2.0 percent ahead for the fiscal year, Gov. Angus King's office said on Friday.
Revenues from individual income tax collections dropped 32 percent in March largely because of refund payments to early-filing taxpayers, spokesman Dennis Bailey said.
Individual income tax revenue collections are running one percent above budget projections for the fiscal year ending June 30.

Corporate income tax revenues were 35 percent above projections for March and are up 27 percent for the year. Sales tax revenues came in as projected in March but are running one percent behind for the year.
